hypothesis: Replace only the Parent's single count-Morgan objective surrogate with a task-local likelihood-weighted model average of exact Tanimoto GPs over three fixed complementary molecular fingerprints: the inherited radius-2 count Morgan representation, an RDKit topological-path representation, and an atom-pair representation. Refit all usable models to the identical oracle-evaluated set each round, derive deterministic model weights from their exact leave-one-out predictive log densities under equal priors, and use the weighted posterior for both pCN probability-of-improvement tilting and greedy expected-improvement batch selection so objective evidence can choose which structural similarity view guides proposals.
method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic SELFIES variational autoencoder on the unlabeled corpus solely as a de novo molecular generator, while fitting the online objective surrogate only on oracle-evaluated molecules using count-based molecular fingerprints and a Tanimoto Gaussian process. At each feedback round, use preconditioned Crank-Nicolson sampling to draw new latent points from the VAE prior tilted by the GP posterior probability of exceeding the incumbent, decode them into previously unseen molecules, and greedily choose a high-utility batch of ten. Decoupling generation from structure-space prediction avoids requiring objective smoothness in the VAE latent geometry and directs the fixed 290 post-initial oracle calls toward molecules likely to improve the final Top-1 rather than screening or retrieving a finite corpus pool.

activation_observables.measurement: For every suggestion round, log each fingerprint name, fit and jitter status, exact per-observation leave-one-out conditional log predictive densities, their arithmetic mean, and the resulting normalized evidence weight. On the same observations, compute the log-sum-exp model-average leave-one-out log predictive density and report its paired mean lift over the inherited Morgan-only value, together with non-Morgan weight mass and the leading representation. Aggregate the signed lift, non-Morgan mass, and leading-model counts by task and round. Parent n-895bba5eb944 has one-hot Morgan weight and zero model-average-versus-Morgan lift; activation predicts positive aggregate predictive-density lift with evidence-consistent non-Morgan allocation rather than a hard-coded uniform ensemble.
activation_observables.name: likelihood_weighted_fingerprint_predictive_lift

activation_observables.measurement: On every pCN sweep, evaluate both the actual likelihood-weighted PI and the inherited Morgan-only PI on the identical current and proposed decoded molecules, reuse the same Metropolis uniforms, and report mean absolute PI difference plus the count and fraction of accept decisions that differ. On the final identical canonical pool, report mean absolute adaptive-versus-Morgan PI and initial EI differences and the overlap between their top-batch-size EI sets. Aggregate these paired quantities across rounds and tasks. The Parent reference is zero difference and complete overlap; activation requires a nonzero aggregate posterior-utility shift that reaches transition decisions or candidate ranking, not merely nonzero bookkeeping weights.

applicability_conditions: Accepted oracle observations have finite, non-tied scores and enough distinct molecular structures for exact leave-one-out evidence to distinguish fingerprint-local generalization; very early or tied histories may correctly use the bounded Morgan fallback.

At least one path- or atom-pair-based similarity view captures task-relevant structure that the inherited radius-2 count Morgan representation aliases. If all three representations induce the same neighborhoods or all miss the decisive feature, adaptive weighting has no leverage.

The corpus-trained VAE continues to decode a large novel-valid pool containing molecules on which the fingerprint posteriors disagree; weighting cannot recover chemistry outside the frozen generator's support.

Leave-one-out predictive density is sufficiently stable under the sparse 10-to-290 observation regime to guide model averaging. A few outliers or overconfident near-duplicate predictions can misallocate weight despite regularization.

Model averaging is useful when task-relevant similarity changes across objectives or feedback rounds; a uniformly superior Morgan view should collapse back toward the Parent and yield little gain rather than forcing diversity.

The three exact GP fits and matched diagnostic counterfactual remain within the supplied offline runtime and memory limits; failed optional fits are omitted without changing canonicalization, proposal uniqueness, or batch completion.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism did not happen if usable alternative fingerprints never receive evidence-consistent non-Morgan weight, if the model-average leave-one-out log predictive-density lift over the inherited Morgan GP is non-positive in aggregate, or if the weighted posterior leaves both matched pCN decisions and final-pool PI/EI rankings indistinguishable from their Morgan-only counterfactuals. Any of these outcomes would refute the proposed mediation from complementary structural evidence to changed proposal allocation even if all batches still fill.
research_intent.implementation_change: Keep corpus sampling and VAE preparation, the trained generator and stochastic decoder, session seeding, chain count and pCN proposal schedule, PI target strength, pool size and sweep bounds, greedy Kriging-believer batch procedure, feedback timing, canonicalization, evaluated/proposed novelty filters, announced batch size, and JSONL protocol unchanged. In run mode, cache a three-representation fingerprint bundle for every canonical molecule instead of only the inherited Morgan vector. Extend the exact GP with its regularized exact leave-one-out conditional log predictive densities; at every round fit one otherwise-identical GP per representation to all and only accepted oracle observations, convert the finite mean leave-one-out log densities to normalized exponential weights with equal model priors, and form weighted model-averaged PI plus moment-matched posterior mean and joint covariance for the existing pCN and EI consumers. A failed non-Morgan fit is omitted and the surviving weights are renormalized; non-finite evidence, absence of an alternative usable model, or degenerate evidence deterministically falls back to weight one on the inherited Morgan GP, preserving the Parent's bounded behavior. Retain a Morgan-only counterfactual on the exact same proposed latents and final pool solely for activation telemetry; it must never emit extra oracle proposals or alter adaptive state.

Refit all usable models to the identical oracle-evaluated set each round, derive deterministic model weights from their exact leave-one-out predictive log densities under equal priors, and use the weighted posterior for both pCN probability-of-improvement tilting and greedy expected-improvement batch selection so objective evidence can choose which structural similarity view guides proposals.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent n-895bba5eb944 generates large valid novel pools and its acquisition ranks them consistently, but the only objective model is one radius-2 count-Morgan Tanimoto GP. Its posterior tilt is strongly representation- and task-dependent: the posterior-versus-prior PI lift is positive in only 3 of 29 zaleplon_mpo rounds with mean 1.1947511043448278e-07, selected-batch EI lift on that task is only 3.0909406350689663e-06, and terminal Top-1 remains 0.08458763933182971 on drd2_docking and 0.1694581623260221 on median_2. This is not a generation-capacity failure: all 145 rounds formed pools of at least 240 molecules, aggregate novel-valid decode yield was 0.9081992337164757, and every batch filled. Cross-lineage node n-d473bfe7172d further shows that exact Tanimoto predictors over complementary Morgan, RDKit-path, and atom-pair fingerprints can all fit the same sparse oracle histories and produce positive multi-fingerprint EI selection lift on all 145 rounds, including 0.00269491059855388 on zaleplon_mpo. The limiting Parent behavior is therefore committing both posterior tilting and acquisition to one fixed structural similarity view even when its predicted improvement collapses.
research_intent.revisit_rationale: Cluster c-a3ba0c6fb3 is Knowledge-only after n-895bba5eb944: it confirmed posterior-tilted latent generation and EI selection, but explicitly left transfer uncertain when the objective is aliased by the radius-2 count fingerprint and documented numerical-floor PI on zaleplon_mpo. This Child does not simply repeat that mechanism. It tests a new explanation for the earlier weak result by changing the objective model from a fixed single representation to oracle-evidence-weighted complementary representations while preserving the Parent's generator, pCN, and acquisition consumers. Node n-d473bfe7172d supplies new campaign evidence unavailable to the cluster's round-0 result that all three exact fingerprint predictors can operate throughout the frozen sparse-feedback protocol and that their combined EI can move selection on every task.

applicability_conditions: The sparse-history fitting prerequisite held under the evaluated protocol: every task had 300 unique canonical structures; all 1,500 scores were finite; every 10-to-290 training prefix had at least 10 distinct scores; and all three exact predictors fit in every one of 145 rounds with finite evidence, zero added jitter, and no fallback.

Complementary fingerprint evidence was most clearly useful on zaleplon_mpo, where atom pair led 29/29 rounds and mean model-average leave-one-out lift was 0.2704642816601605. It was positive in aggregate on deco_hop and drd2_docking as well. Current evidence does not support the same condition on median_2 or sitagliptin_mpo, where Morgan led every round and model averaging reduced leave-one-out density in every round.

The frozen generator supplied enough disagreement-bearing support: candidate and Parent used the identical prepared-artifact content hash, all 145 rounds formed pools of 254 to 339 canonical novel molecules, mean novel-valid decode yield was 0.9105938697318009, final-pool adaptive-versus-Morgan PI and EI differed in every round, and every announced batch filled with no evaluator-level invalid or duplicate proposals.

The weighted posterior affected both downstream consumers under the inherited schedule: matched pCN decisions differed in 113/145 rounds and top-10 initial-EI membership differed in 144/145 rounds. Applicability is weaker when PI is numerically flat; ranking changes can remain even when pCN decisions do not.

The three-fit surrogate and matched diagnostic counterfactual completed all five tasks in 280.48433350099367 seconds total under the supplied six-core, one-GPU profile; individual task sessions took 45.939264735003235 to 68.59994102999917 seconds, well inside the 3,600-second task timeout.

Evidence is limited to seed 0, batch size 10, 29 feedback rounds, and the frozen 300-call objectives. Transfer is not established for tied or non-finite histories, failed alternative fits, objectives on which all representations induce indistinguishable neighborhoods, or generators whose decoded pool lacks posterior disagreement.

possible_failure_causes: The positive aggregate leave-one-out lift is concentrated rather than broad: only 52/145 rounds were positive, and all 29 median_2 rounds and all 29 sitagliptin_mpo rounds were negative. Morgan led every round on both tasks, yet mean non-Morgan mass remained 0.6376928138994411 and 0.6595222421330109. Softmax weighting of arithmetic mean per-observation evidence therefore stayed close to one-third per model and did not collapse toward the superior Morgan view, which can dilute task-local signal.

The pCN mediation was weaker near numerical floors or collapsed posteriors. Accept decisions were unchanged in 32/145 rounds; zaleplon_mpo changed only 24/10,440 decisions across 3/29 rounds despite atom pair leading throughout, and drd2_docking had exactly zero matched pCN PI difference in rounds 26-29. Final-pool EI rankings still changed, so this does not trigger the falsifier, but it limits claims that every evidence shift improves latent transition allocation.

Terminal reward response was task-dependent in the single replica. The trusted seed-0 macro score increased from Parent 0.279808892525444 to candidate 0.415279439790754, but the 0.13547054726531 difference was dominated by drd2_docking (+0.8558542861091867); candidate Top-1 decreased on deco_hop (-0.0072025244454568815), median_2 (-0.0016195028468891925), and sitagliptin_mpo (-0.1978774994091427). Confirmed intermediate activation therefore does not establish uniformly beneficial score mediation.

The generator and its support were intentionally frozen. Likelihood weighting can redirect posterior utility only among molecules decoded by the inherited VAE and cannot recover decisive chemistry outside that support.

Only seed 0 was evaluated. It decisively establishes formula execution and matched intermediate shifts for this replica, but not multi-seed stability of the evidence weights, task-level predictive lift, or terminal score effect.

Each sweep evaluates the likelihood-weighted and Morgan-only PI on the same 120 current and 120 proposed decoded states and reuses the same 120 Metropolis uniforms, totaling 104,400 paired PI values and 52,200 paired accept decisions. The arithmetic mean round-level absolute PI difference was 0.007754327556734022, with range 0.0 to 0.016705730607278157; it was positive in 141/145 rounds. Accept decisions differed 3,487/52,200 times, fraction 0.06680076628352491, and at least one decision differed in 113/145 rounds. On the identical final canonical pools, comprising 44,526 molecules and 254 to 339 molecules per round, the arithmetic mean round-level absolute adaptive-versus-Morgan PI difference was 0.008265459785629408 and the initial-EI difference was 0.0002421748249157286; both final-pool differences were positive in all 145 rounds. Pooled over molecules, the corresponding differences were 0.007999952839146654 and 0.00024280865458074834. The mean overlap of the adaptive and Morgan top-10 initial-EI sets was 0.5275862068965518, or 765/1,450 positions, with range 0.0 to 1.0; overlap was incomplete in 144/145 rounds. Task-level arithmetic means for pCN PI difference, differing decisions, final-pool PI difference, final-pool initial-EI difference, and top-10 overlap were respectively: deco_hop 0.014325047047635158, 1,125/10,440 (0.10775862068965517), 0.015126280726631984, 0.00036974776158909585, and 0.5241379310344827; drd2_docking 0.006023877773705463, 691/10,440 (0.06618773946360153), 0.006328329062810828, 0.0001914436253555679, and 0.5689655172413793; median_2 0.011631992751765928, 1,419/10,440 (0.13591954022988506), 0.0127780279249506, 0.00023239788314102116, and 0.5413793103448276; sitagliptin_mpo 0.006741259190284615, 228/10,440 (0.021839080459770115), 0.007052846027694715, 0.0004158717776644894, and 0.7275862068965517; and zaleplon_mpo 0.000049461020278946924, 24/10,440 (0.0022988505747126436), 0.00004181518605890955, 0.0000014130768284687867, and 0.27586206896551724. The weighted posterior therefore reached both transition decisions and candidate ranking rather than changing weights only in bookkeeping.

possible_failure_causes: The positive aggregate leave-one-out lift is concentrated rather than broad: only 52/145 rounds were positive, and all 29 median_2 rounds and all 29 sitagliptin_mpo rounds were negative. Morgan led every round on both tasks, yet mean non-Morgan mass remained 0.6376928138994411 and 0.6595222421330109. Softmax weighting of arithmetic mean per-observation evidence therefore stayed close to one-third per model and did not collapse toward the superior Morgan view, which can dilute task-local signal.

The pCN mediation was weaker near numerical floors or collapsed posteriors. Accept decisions were unchanged in 32/145 rounds; zaleplon_mpo changed only 24/10,440 decisions across 3/29 rounds despite atom pair leading throughout, and drd2_docking had exactly zero matched pCN PI difference in rounds 26-29. Final-pool EI rankings still changed, so this does not trigger the falsifier, but it limits claims that every evidence shift improves latent transition allocation.

Terminal reward response was task-dependent in the single replica. The trusted seed-0 macro score increased from Parent 0.279808892525444 to candidate 0.415279439790754, but the 0.13547054726531 difference was dominated by drd2_docking (+0.8558542861091867); candidate Top-1 decreased on deco_hop (-0.0072025244454568815), median_2 (-0.0016195028468891925), and sitagliptin_mpo (-0.1978774994091427). Confirmed intermediate activation therefore does not establish uniformly beneficial score mediation.

The generator and its support were intentionally frozen. Likelihood weighting can redirect posterior utility only among molecules decoded by the inherited VAE and cannot recover decisive chemistry outside that support.

Only seed 0 was evaluated. It decisively establishes formula execution and matched intermediate shifts for this replica, but not multi-seed stability of the evidence weights, task-level predictive lift, or terminal score effect.

applicability_conditions: The sparse-history fitting prerequisite held under the evaluated protocol: every task had 300 unique canonical structures; all 1,500 scores were finite; every 10-to-290 training prefix had at least 10 distinct scores; and all three exact predictors fit in every one of 145 rounds with finite evidence, zero added jitter, and no fallback.

Complementary fingerprint evidence was most clearly useful on zaleplon_mpo, where atom pair led 29/29 rounds and mean model-average leave-one-out lift was 0.2704642816601605. It was positive in aggregate on deco_hop and drd2_docking as well. Current evidence does not support the same condition on median_2 or sitagliptin_mpo, where Morgan led every round and model averaging reduced leave-one-out density in every round.

The frozen generator supplied enough disagreement-bearing support: candidate and Parent used the identical prepared-artifact content hash, all 145 rounds formed pools of 254 to 339 canonical novel molecules, mean novel-valid decode yield was 0.9105938697318009, final-pool adaptive-versus-Morgan PI and EI differed in every round, and every announced batch filled with no evaluator-level invalid or duplicate proposals.

The weighted posterior affected both downstream consumers under the inherited schedule: matched pCN decisions differed in 113/145 rounds and top-10 initial-EI membership differed in 144/145 rounds. Applicability is weaker when PI is numerically flat; ranking changes can remain even when pCN decisions do not.

The three-fit surrogate and matched diagnostic counterfactual completed all five tasks in 280.48433350099367 seconds total under the supplied six-core, one-GPU profile; individual task sessions took 45.939264735003235 to 68.59994102999917 seconds, well inside the 3,600-second task timeout.

Evidence is limited to seed 0, batch size 10, 29 feedback rounds, and the frozen 300-call objectives. Transfer is not established for tied or non-finite histories, failed alternative fits, objectives on which all representations induce indistinguishable neighborhoods, or generators whose decoded pool lacks posterior disagreement.

applicability_conditions: Accepted oracle observations have finite, non-tied scores and enough distinct molecular structures for exact leave-one-out evidence to distinguish fingerprint-local generalization; very early or tied histories may correctly use the bounded Morgan fallback.

At least one path- or atom-pair-based similarity view captures task-relevant structure that the inherited radius-2 count Morgan representation aliases. If all three representations induce the same neighborhoods or all miss the decisive feature, adaptive weighting has no leverage.

The corpus-trained VAE continues to decode a large novel-valid pool containing molecules on which the fingerprint posteriors disagree; weighting cannot recover chemistry outside the frozen generator's support.

Leave-one-out predictive density is sufficiently stable under the sparse 10-to-290 observation regime to guide model averaging. A few outliers or overconfident near-duplicate predictions can misallocate weight despite regularization.

Model averaging is useful when task-relevant similarity changes across objectives or feedback rounds; a uniformly superior Morgan view should collapse back toward the Parent and yield little gain rather than forcing diversity.

The three exact GP fits and matched diagnostic counterfactual remain within the supplied offline runtime and memory limits; failed optional fits are omitted without changing canonicalization, proposal uniqueness, or batch completion.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism did not happen if usable alternative fingerprints never receive evidence-consistent non-Morgan weight, if the model-average leave-one-out log predictive-density lift over the inherited Morgan GP is non-positive in aggregate, or if the weighted posterior leaves both matched pCN decisions and final-pool PI/EI rankings indistinguishable from their Morgan-only counterfactuals. Any of these outcomes would refute the proposed mediation from complementary structural evidence to changed proposal allocation even if all batches still fill.
research_intent.implementation_change: Keep corpus sampling and VAE preparation, the trained generator and stochastic decoder, session seeding, chain count and pCN proposal schedule, PI target strength, pool size and sweep bounds, greedy Kriging-believer batch procedure, feedback timing, canonicalization, evaluated/proposed novelty filters, announced batch size, and JSONL protocol unchanged. In run mode, cache a three-representation fingerprint bundle for every canonical molecule instead of only the inherited Morgan vector. Extend the exact GP with its regularized exact leave-one-out conditional log predictive densities; at every round fit one otherwise-identical GP per representation to all and only accepted oracle observations, convert the finite mean leave-one-out log densities to normalized exponential weights with equal model priors, and form weighted model-averaged PI plus moment-matched posterior mean and joint covariance for the existing pCN and EI consumers. A failed non-Morgan fit is omitted and the surviving weights are renormalized; non-finite evidence, absence of an alternative usable model, or degenerate evidence deterministically falls back to weight one on the inherited Morgan GP, preserving the Parent's bounded behavior. Retain a Morgan-only counterfactual on the exact same proposed latents and final pool solely for activation telemetry; it must never emit extra oracle proposals or alter adaptive state.
research_intent.mechanism: Replace only the Parent's single count-Morgan objective surrogate with a task-local likelihood-weighted model average of exact Tanimoto GPs over three fixed complementary molecular fingerprints: the inherited radius-2 count Morgan representation, an RDKit topological-path representation, and an atom-pair representation. Refit all usable models to the identical oracle-evaluated set each round, derive deterministic model weights from their exact leave-one-out predictive log densities under equal priors, and use the weighted posterior for both pCN probability-of-improvement tilting and greedy expected-improvement batch selection so objective evidence can choose which structural similarity view guides proposals.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent n-895bba5eb944 generates large valid novel pools and its acquisition ranks them consistently, but the only objective model is one radius-2 count-Morgan Tanimoto GP. Its posterior tilt is strongly representation- and task-dependent: the posterior-versus-prior PI lift is positive in only 3 of 29 zaleplon_mpo rounds with mean 1.1947511043448278e-07, selected-batch EI lift on that task is only 3.0909406350689663e-06, and terminal Top-1 remains 0.08458763933182971 on drd2_docking and 0.1694581623260221 on median_2. This is not a generation-capacity failure: all 145 rounds formed pools of at least 240 molecules, aggregate novel-valid decode yield was 0.9081992337164757, and every batch filled. Cross-lineage node n-d473bfe7172d further shows that exact Tanimoto predictors over complementary Morgan, RDKit-path, and atom-pair fingerprints can all fit the same sparse oracle histories and produce positive multi-fingerprint EI selection lift on all 145 rounds, including 0.00269491059855388 on zaleplon_mpo. The limiting Parent behavior is therefore committing both posterior tilting and acquisition to one fixed structural similarity view even when its predicted improvement collapses.
research_intent.revisit_rationale: Cluster c-a3ba0c6fb3 is Knowledge-only after n-895bba5eb944: it confirmed posterior-tilted latent generation and EI selection, but explicitly left transfer uncertain when the objective is aliased by the radius-2 count fingerprint and documented numerical-floor PI on zaleplon_mpo. This Child does not simply repeat that mechanism. It tests a new explanation for the earlier weak result by changing the objective model from a fixed single representation to oracle-evidence-weighted complementary representations while preserving the Parent's generator, pCN, and acquisition consumers. Node n-d473bfe7172d supplies new campaign evidence unavailable to the cluster's round-0 result that all three exact fingerprint predictors can operate throughout the frozen sparse-feedback protocol and that their combined EI can move selection on every task.
